positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed the new Client Relations Management tool that allowed for realtors to easily keep in contact with their leads. Responsibilities included:
- Create the new UI components using React.js and Redux
- Developed new endpoints (ranging from mySQL queries to 3rd party APIs) in PHP Laravel
- Managed API calls through redux saga
- Integrated Twilio API and Google Calendar API within the application
- Wrote both unit and integrated tests for the frontend components using Jest and Enzyme

projects.title: Science On Ice Consultation- Pueblo Science
projects.description: Working with Pueblo Science to deliver a design for an experiment that would be displayed on ice during a varsity hockey game half-time show. The design is aimed to be visible by approximately 4000 people, within the designated time frame, entertaining, and STEM field related. Process involves formal documentation of stakeholders, service environment, functions, constraints, and eventually documentation of all potential design solutions. As as assistant team leader, additional tasks includes arranging client meetings, optimizing distribution of work, and scheduling.

projects.title: Food Packaging System Consultation-(Mock Client)
projects.description: Assigned a design project for a mock client for the ESP(Engineering Strategies Practices) course throughout the semester. Design had pertained to a container that retained heat while optimizing the cost. As a team we had wrote a 3000 word Conceptual Designs Specification outlining potential alternative designs with metrics and a proposed design. My role as a team leader involved distributing work amongst team members and planning team meetings.
